subject: Request: VM evidence, CVE attestations and SOC2 mapping for Q3 audit
messages:
From: Avery Sullivan <security@finpartner.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Audits Team <audits@thirdparty-auditors.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SOC2/SIG VM evidence and CVE attestations for Q3 audit

Hi Grace,

We're kicking off FinPartner's quarterly compliance intake and the auditors have asked us to collect Redwood's vulnerability management evidence for SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ review. Specifically they want:

- Scan cadence for external and internal network/application scans for the last 90 days (schedule + sample timestamps).
- SLA definitions for CVE remediation by severity class and any real exceptions in the period.
- Attestations (signed) for remediation of two CVEs that showed up in our scan: CVE-2026-34567 and CVE-2026-39821.
- Any independent validation logs (post-patch scans) and a short statement mapping to SIG control TIG-VM-02.

Can you provide a single evidence packet (PDF preferred) or a Drive link with these artifacts by end of day Friday 2026-09-03? Also please include a named point of contact who can sign an attestation letter on Redwood letterhead.

Thanks — we need to submit to the auditors next Monday.

Best,
Avery Sullivan
Lead Information Security Manager
FinPartner Inc.

---
Attachment stubs requested: scan-schedule.csv, sample-scan-logs.zip
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Avery Sullivan <security@finpartner.com>
Cc: Audits Team <audits@thirdparty-auditors.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2/SIG VM evidence and CVE attestations for Q3 audit

Avery — thanks for the heads up. We're on it.

Quick plan / POC:
- Monica Patel (Security Ops) will assemble the scan cadence + sample logs and provide a CSV index.
- Ben Carter (Compliance) will draft the attestation language and map the artifacts to SIG/TIG-VM-02.
- I'll collate the packet, export the PDF on letterhead, and confirm the signer (VP Security).

Preliminary timing: Monica can deliver scan-index.csv and the validation log for CVE-2026-34567 by EOD tomorrow (2026-09-02). The remediation plan for CVE-2026-39821 is currently scheduled and I expect a committed remediation date by 2026-09-05; we will include the remediation schedule and a follow-up validation scan as soon as it's complete.

Attachments I will include in the packet: scan-index.csv, cve-commitments.pdf (draft), and attestation-draft.docx. I'll also share a Drive folder.

Link to working folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_vm_evidence
HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/FP-9876

If you need the attestation signed by an executive earlier than the final validation scan, tell us and we can provide a signed remediation-attestation that references follow-up validation scans.

-G
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments (to be delivered): scan-index.csv, cve-commitments.pdf, attestation-draft.docx
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Avery Sullivan <security@finpartner.com>, Audits Team <audits@thirdparty-auditors.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T03:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2/SIG VM evidence and CVE attestations for Q3 audit

Grace / Team / Avery — attaching the first-pass artifacts. See notes below.

Summary of findings and actions (concise):
- CVE-2026-34567 (critical, nginx module): Patch pushed to prod 2026-09-02T10:10:00Z. Post-patch validation scan passed 2026-09-02T14:02:00Z. Validation log attached as validation-log-34567.txt.
- CVE-2026-39821 (high, third-party library): Mitigation applied to staging 2026-09-02T22:30:00Z; final production rollout scheduled 2026-09-05T04:00:00Z. Remediation schedule attached as remediation-schedule-39821.csv.

Scan cadence:
- Internal host scans: weekly (every Monday 03:00 UTC).
- External application scans: bi-weekly (Tuesday & Friday 05:00 UTC).
- Continuous authenticated scans for critical assets every 24 hours.

SLA: Standard remediation SLA by severity: P0/P1 = 30 days (escalate to executive triage for exceptions), P2 = 90 days, P3+ = 180 days. For the two CVEs above we opened an accelerated track given public exploitability.

Attachments included: scan-index.csv, validation-log-34567.txt, remediation-schedule-39821.csv. Full raw logs are in the Drive folder; let us know if you want the archived scan logs.

Monica Patel
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs: validation-log-34567.txt, remediation-schedule-39821.csv
From: Avery Sullivan <security@finpartner.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Audits Team <audits@thirdparty-auditors.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2/SIG VM evidence and CVE attestations for Q3 audit

Grace / Monica / Ben — thank you, this is exactly what we hoped for. A couple of follow-ups before we close the intake: 

1) The auditors want an explicit attestation letter on Redwood letterhead that lists the two CVEs, the remediation dates and the name/title of the signer. Can Ben or Grace provide a signed PDF (scanned signature or DocuSign) by tomorrow EOD 2026-09-04?

2) They also asked for a one-page mapping that shows how your process maps to SIG control TIG-VM-02 (vulnerability scanning cadence, triage and remediation SLAs). Ben indicated he'd draft this — please include it in the packet.

3) Finally, auditors prefer a single consolidated PDF when possible. If you can consolidate the CSVs and logs into an appendix and produce a single PDF (with bookmarks), that would speed review.

If you're able to provide the signed attestation and the SIG mapping by EOD tomorrow we'll mark this intake complete. Appreciate the rapid response.

Best,
Avery
Lead Information Security Manager
FinPartner Inc.

---
Requested deliverable: consolidated PDF with attestation; auditors will accept DocuSign.
